annotations.title: Find products by ingredients and nutrition

description:
Find products that meet ingredient, nutrition, alcohol or offer
    conditions, optionally sorted. For questions like "biscuits without palm
    oil", "nut-free snacks at Tesco", "vegan chocolate", "cereal with the least
    sugar", "high protein yoghurt", "bread with the fewest ingredients",
    "alcohol-free beer", "low salt soup" or "cheapest olive oil at Aldi".
    Every product comes with its nutrition, ingredients, ingredient count,
    country of origin where stated and today's price. Fibre and saturated fat
    are not recorded.

    Ingredient words. exclude_ingredients are ingredients a product is free
    of; include_ingredients ones it contains. These words are expanded to the
    label terms they cover: palm oil, nuts (includes peanuts), peanuts, gluten,
    milk (dairy), eggs, soya, sesame, mustard, celery, fish, crustaceans,
    molluscs, shellfish, sulphites, lupin, gelatine, alcohol, added sugar,
    sweeteners, pork, meat, vegetarian (meat, fish, gelatine and other
    animal-derived ingredients) and vegan (vegetarian plus milk, eggs, honey and
    other animal products). Any other word is matched as written, e.g.
    "coconut" or "oats".

    With no store, results alternate across the stores (each store's best
    match, then each store's next), and matched_by_store gives each store's
    full count.

    A product whose ingredient list or nutrition is not on record, or whose
    ingredient list on record is incomplete, is left out, never assumed to
    pass: left_out_unknown counts them, left_out_by_reason gives the reasons,
    and caveats lists known gaps (Aldi's ingredient lists are often cut short,
    so Aldi products are not offered as free from anything). Claims printed in
    a product's NAME, such as "gluten free", "lactose free", "alcohol free" or
    "vegan", are matched through query; exclude_ingredients also checks the
    ingredients. Alcohol strength is recorded for most SuperValu, Dunnes and
    Tesco drinks but few at Aldi or Lidl; "alcohol free" and "0.0" in query
    match drinks named that way.

    Answers come from the ingredient lists and nutrition the retailers publish.
    "Free from" means none of the listed ingredients names it; not every
    "may contain" warning is covered. Results carry a note that this is information
    only. Each product returned costs one credit.

    Args:
        query: product words, e.g. "biscuits", "crisps", "dark chocolate".
            Needed unless category is given.
        store: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl. Leave out to search all five.
        category: an aisle or shelf to narrow by, e.g. "Breakfast Cereals"
            or "Kefir". A store with no aisle or shelf of that name is searched
            by product name instead, and caveats say so.
        exclude_ingredients: ingredients a product has to be free of, e.g.
            ["palm oil"], ["nuts", "sesame"], ["vegan"]. A product whose
            allergy advice says it contains or may contain one is left out
            too, and counted in left_out_may_contain.
        include_ingredients: e.g. ["oats"].
        max_sugar_g, max_salt_g, max_fat_g, max_carbs_g, min_protein_g:
            grams per 100g or 100ml, e.g. max_sugar_g=5.
        max_kcal: kilocalories per 100g or 100ml.
        max_abv, min_abv: alcohol by volume, percent.
        max_ingredients: at most this many listed ingredients, e.g. 5. A
            compound ingredient's own bracketed list counts as one.
        on_offer: only products on promotion or with a member price
            (Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards, Lidl Plus).
        origin: country of origin, e.g. "Ireland" (or "Irish"); several may be
            given comma-separated. A product matches only when every country its
            label states is one asked for: "Made in Ireland" with "EU chicken" is
            not Irish chicken, and is counted in left_out_partly_from_origin.
            Northern Ireland answers for Ireland (one island, one Bord Bia
            scheme), not the other way round. Products with no stated origin are
            counted in left_out_unknown, not returned. A provenance word in the
            query works too: "Irish honey" searches honey from Ireland.
        sort_by: price, unit_price (per kg or litre), sugar, salt, fat, carbs,
            protein, kcal, abv or ingredients (fewest first). Products that
            are the kind of thing searched for rank ahead of name-only matches
            (name_match_only), so "chocolate" sorted by price does not lead
            with chocolate-flavour popcorn.
        descending: true for highest first, e.g. most protein.
        limit: most products to return (default 10, max 50).
name: find_products

alcohol_abv_source.description: Where the strength came from: the retailer's own listing, worked out from its alcohol units per bottle or can, or the same barcode at another store
alcohol_abv_source.title: Alcohol Abv Source

allergy_advice.description: The retailer's allergy advice: what the product contains and may contain, e.g. 'May contain: Nuts.'
allergy_advice.title: Allergy Advice

clubcard_price.description: Member price where one applies: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price

ingredient_count.description: How many ingredients the label lists (a compound ingredient's own bracketed list counts as one)
ingredient_count.title: Ingredient Count

ingredients.description: As printed; very long lists are shortened
ingredients.title: Ingredients

ingredients_incomplete.description: True when the list on record appears cut short
ingredients_incomplete.title: Ingredients Incomplete

name_match_only.description: True when only the name matched the search, not the kind of product: chocolate popcorn for 'chocolate'. Sorted results list these last
name_match_only.title: Name Match Only

origin.description: Every country the label states, e.g. 'Ireland' or 'Ireland, EU, non-EU'
origin.title: Origin

shelf_path.description: Where the retailer shelves it, every level, e.g. 'Fresh Food > Yoghurts > Kefir > Kefir Drinks'
shelf_path.title: Shelf Path

unit_basis.description: The unit unit_price is measured in
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

caveats.description: Limits of this answer: pass them on
caveats.title: Caveats

left_out_by_reason.description: Why products were left out, with counts
left_out_by_reason.title: Left Out By Reason

left_out_may_contain.description: With ingredients excluded: products whose ingredient list passed but whose allergy advice says they contain or may contain one, left out
left_out_may_contain.title: Left Out May Contain

left_out_may_contain_examples.description: A few of those, each with its allergy advice
left_out_may_contain_examples.title: Left Out May Contain Examples

left_out_other_kind.description: Products that only mention the search words but are a different kind of product (honey roast ham for 'honey'), left out
left_out_other_kind.title: Left Out Other Kind

left_out_partly_from_origin.description: With an origin asked for: products whose label names that country AND another ('Made in Ireland' from 'EU chicken'), left out as not wholly from it
left_out_partly_from_origin.title: Left Out Partly From Origin

left_out_partly_from_origin_examples.description: A few of those, each with the origin it states
left_out_partly_from_origin_examples.title: Left Out Partly From Origin Examples

left_out_unknown.description: Left out because the ingredients, nutrition or value a filter or sort needs is not on record for them, or the ingredient list is incomplete
left_out_unknown.title: Left Out Unknown

matched_by_store.description: How many products passed at each store (more than are returned)
matched_by_store.title: Matched By Store
